title: An arbitrary-order BGG-based discrete scheme for the Reissner--Mindlin plate problem on polygonal meshes
summary: We design and analyse an arbitrary-order numerical scheme for the Reissner--Mindlin plate problem on general polygonal meshes. The scheme is derived from the Hodge--Laplacian associated with a discrete Bernstein--Gelfand--Gelfand (BGG) twisted complex and exploits a discrete $H_2$-based construction for the transverse displacement. We establish a discrete Korn inequality for the underlying Discrete de Rham method (DDR) spaces and prove the convergence of the method.
